title: Notifications
pageDescription: Everything that happened while you were away — recurring posts, reminders and alerts.
emptyDescription: New activity — auto-posted recurring transactions, reminders and alerts — shows up here.

ended.title: Recurring ended
ended.body: {{ruleTitle}} reached its end date and has stopped.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.body: {{ruleTitle}} was due {{date}} ({{amount}}) and hasn't posted yet.

cycle_rolled.title: Goal restarted
cycle_rolled.body_one: {{name}} finished a round and is saving {{amount}} again by {{date}}.
cycle_rolled.body_other: {{name}} rolled through {{count}} rounds and is saving {{amount}} again by {{date}}.

behind.title: Goal running late
behind.body: At {{amount}}/month, {{name}} won't reach its target by {{date}}.

matured.title: Deposit matured
matured.body: {{name}} has finished. Record the payout to move the {{amount}} back into an account.
